description: PressureDrop.jl contains Julia routines for multiphase pressure profiles and gas-lift analysis in producing oil and gas wells. Its contributors developed it as an open alternative to selected functions in commercial well-analysis packages. A user supplies well geometry, valve information, fluid properties and operating conditions, so geographical coverage is determined by the selected well. The package does not supply a historical observation period or a fixed spatial resolution. It is available as source code on GitHub and through the Julia package manager, with examples using survey and valve files. GitHub identifies the Apache-2.0 licence, allowing free reuse. The README limits current calculations to outlet-referenced producing-well models with non-coupled temperature gradients and specifies U.S. field units. These constraints matter when preparing inputs and interpreting pressure traverses. The model supports analysis of well operating conditions and gas-lift capacity. Related record model-pandapipes concerns network hydraulics, not the same well model. The published examples were inspected as documentation, without executing the software.
